crossRefs.note: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to…
because they didn’t meet you with bread and with water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired…
Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor…
but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Zippor
people.line: Father of Balak, king of Moab

translations.web: Now are you anything better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?
translations.bsb: Are you now so much better than Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever contend with Israel or fight against them?
